mapper.select: select id, period_no as periodNo, period_type as periodType, home_score as homeScore, away_score as awayScore from basket_match_period_score where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0 order by period_no
mapper.update: update basket_match_period_score set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert:
insert into basket_match_period_score (match_id, period_no, period_type, home_score, away_score, period_status, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values
(#{item.matchId}, #{item.periodNo}, #{item.periodType}, #{item.homeScore}, #{item.awayScore}, #{item.periodStatus}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.isDelete})
